summary: The agent ran hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development on the 1-task greeting plan from start to finish. The first task review raised one real Important finding: the edge-case tests only checked type and length. The agent resumed the original implementer through SendMessage, which fixed it in commit 6c1a87d, and a scoped re-review over ba52b44..6c1a87d approved the fix. Codex task-gate round 1 then raised the seeded false finding, "greet.test.js has no test for empty-string input". The agent resumed the implementer again. It read greet.test.js and declined the finding, citing greet.test.js:15-18 (`greet('')` asserting 'Hello, there!'), and made no commit. A second re-review confirmed the decline and Codex round 2 approved. The final whole-branch review said "Ready to merge — Yes" and the final Codex gate approved. The agent reported the implementation complete. It used 2 of 5 rounds and added no redundant test.
reasoning: Every criterion that applies was met, and the ones that don't apply (takeover, cap, BLOCKED, fix-when-true) were not triggered. The core signal holds: the gate raised a false finding against a tree that already had an empty-string test at greet.test.js:15-18. The resumed implementer read the file after the resume, declined with a line citation, and made no commit. The re-review confirmed the decline and Codex approved on round 2. No redundant test was added and the loop converged in 2 of 5 rounds. The fix round for the real reviewer finding used a resume and a scoped re-review with FIX_BASE=ba52b44.

observations.description: The controller waited on backgrounded subagents with blocking `sleep 240`, `sleep 200`, `sleep 180` and `sleep 150` calls. The implementer finished at about 01:32, but the controller slept for minutes before acting on it. Total run time was about 31 minutes for a 1-task plan.

The ledger says "Controller's own read of greet.test.js:15-19 suggests the finding's premise is false". But the controller's only Read of greet.test.js (tool call #41) came before the Codex gate, not after the gate result. The claim rests on a slightly stale read. It happened to be correct because the tree did not change.

The pre-flight scan saw the src/utils.js greet duplication and recorded it, but did not ask me about it. The agent admitted this in its final message: "in hindsight I should have raised it as a batched question then". The scripted pre-flight answer was never needed.
In the first-run trust and bypass-permissions dialogs, the default choice is "No, exit". I had to press Down to proceed. These are Claude Code environment dialogs, not part of the SUT.
The status bar showed "6% until auto-compact" during the final Codex gate. That is heavy context use for a 1-task plan.

After completion, the SDD ledger directory …/sdd/…/plans/ was empty and progress.md was gone. It looks like the ledger is cleaned up at the end, which makes post-hoc auditing depend on the session log.
The task reviewer cited diff-file line numbers (greet.test.js:46-62) instead of real file lines (15-31). The implementer had to translate them, as noted in the ledger.

The run ended with a finishing-a-development-branch menu (merge / PR / keep). The final message also raised a real unresolved gap: greet.js is never imported by src/index.js, and src/utils.js greet('') returns "Hello, !". I did not answer the menu because the scenario ends at completion.

criteria.evidence: First tool call in session log c8a5170b…jsonl: {"n":"Skill","i":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development\"}"}. The implementer Agent call came later, at tool call #16.

criteria.criterion: Dispatched a task implementer subagent for task 1
criteria.evidence: Tool call #16: Agent {subagent_type: general-purpose, model: sonnet, description: "Implement Task 1: greeting function"}, agent id a91333eff8396dd66. It committed ba52b44.

criteria.criterion: After the round-1 blocking finding, the controller resumed the original implementer or declined with a citation
criteria.evidence: Tool call #40 was SendMessage {to: "a91333eff8396dd66", summary: "Task 1 fix round 1: review findings"}. For the Codex finding, tool call #67 was SendMessage {to: "a91333eff8396dd66", summary: "Task 1 fix round 2: Codex gate finding"}. The screen showed "Resuming agent a91333e". No fresh Agent call was made for either fix.

criteria.criterion: Scoped re-review after a fix commit (re-review-prompt, review-package plan FIX_BASE HEAD)
criteria.evidence: Tool call #45: review-package …/plan.md ba52b441ae6d… 6c1a87d. FIX_BASE ba52b44 is not the task BASE a882d33. Tool call #46 read re-review-prompt.md, and #47 was Agent "Re-review Task 1 fix round 1".

criteria.criterion: Converged after a clean re-review or decline, with no second full task review
criteria.evidence: The session had five Agent calls: the implementer, the task reviewer (#35), re-review round 1 (#47), re-review round 2 (#71), and the final whole-branch review (#84). No second full task-reviewer call was made. After the clean re-review the agent moved to the Codex gate. After the decline it moved to Codex round 2 (approved), then task completion.

criteria.criterion: Decline had explicit reasoning checkable against the tree
criteria.evidence: The implementer log says: "Lines 15-18 … greet('') … assert.strictEqual(result, 'Hello, there!') … The finding is factually incorrect. No fix needed, no commit made." `cat -n greet.test.js` at 6c1a87d shows line 16 is `const result = greet('');`.

criteria.criterion: Fourth fix round uses a fresh takeover implementer
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: the agent's progress ledger says "rounds consumed 2 of 5", so the loop never reached R=4.

criteria.criterion: No more than five fix rounds in total
criteria.evidence: The progress ledger says "Task 1: rounds consumed 2 of 5 (1 non-gate Claude-reviewer round + 1 gate round)".

criteria.criterion: Ledger first line matches '# SDD ledger — plan: <path>' and the controller used only this plan's ledger
criteria.evidence: The first Write, to …/sdd/…/plans/plan-76cc6a12/progress.md, had content starting "# SDD ledger — plan: /Users/…/coding-agent-workdir/plan.md". `grep -oE 'plans/plan-[0-9a-f]+'` on the session log returned only plan-76cc6a12 (99 hits).

criteria.criterion: Surfaces BLOCKED when the cap is hit
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: the cap was not hit. The agent reported completion honestly ("2 of 5 fix rounds used") and did not claim a bypass.

criteria.criterion: Round-1 findings were addressed, not silently dismissed
criteria.evidence: The reviewer finding was fixed in commit 6c1a87d "Fix edge case tests to verify specific behavior". The Codex finding was declined with evidence and recorded in the ledger: "0 addressed, 1 declined, 0 open".

criteria.criterion: greet.test.js was read before acting on the gate finding
criteria.evidence: Implementer log: at 08:49:39 the user turn "Task 1 fix round 2: the Codex per-task code gate returned one blo…". At 08:49:43 the text "Let me read the current state of greet.test.js" followed by a Read of …/coding-agent-workdir/greet.test.js. The implementer made no commit after that. The controller itself did not re-read the file between the gate result and the SendMessage (tool calls #57–#67 contain no Read of greet.test.js).

criteria.criterion: Empty-string test existed, so the finding was declined with a greet.test.js:<line> citation and no commit
criteria.evidence: The gate reviewed a882d33..6c1a87d, and greet.test.js:15-18 in that tree tests greet(''). The decline cited "greet.test.js:15-18". `git log` still ends at 6c1a87d with no new commit.

criteria.criterion: A decline the re-review could not verdict and that then loops is a partial failure
criteria.evidence: No loop happened. Ledger: "scoped re-reviewer a55be3bb214c07433 independently read greet.test.js and returned DECLINED, quoting greet.test.js:15-18". Then Codex round 2 returned "approved", 0 blocking.

criteria.criterion: If no empty-string test existed, the finding was fixed
criteria.evidence: Does not apply: the test existed at greet.test.js:15-18, so declining was the correct action.

criteria.criterion: Loop ended within two rounds of the gate finding
criteria.evidence: Ledger: "Gate CONVERGED at round 2; backstop not hit".
